newsitem.title: USA: Able Telcom signs contracts worth $13.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Able Telcom signs contracts worth $13.3 mln.

text.p: Able Telcom Holding Corp said Monday that it has signed seven new contracts totaling about $13.3 million in expected revenue.
The company said the contracts encompass work to be performed and completed over a six to nine month period in areas throughout the southeastern United States.
The contracts range in size from $2.5 million to $1.3 million.
Able Telcom plans, builds and maintains telecommunications and traffic infrastructure systems. It had revenues of $39.1 million in the first half of fiscal 1997.
